---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement to the starter, a template, or a package
title: '[feat] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Use case**
What are you trying to build or do? Describe the job to be done, not just the solution.

**Which package / area?**
- [ ] `create-wakii-stack` — full platform scaffold (services / compose / gateway)
- [ ] `create-wakii-app` — FE starter
- [ ] `@wakii/ui-kit` — design system
- [ ] Boilerplate repo itself — contracts, a service, docs, CI

**Proposed solution**
What you would like to happen. If you already have a workaround, describe it — it helps
calibrate the real need.

**Alternatives considered**
Other approaches you weighed, including "do nothing" and why that falls short.

**Additional context**
Mockups, related ADRs ([docs/adr/](../docs/adr/)), or prior art in other starters.
